Name: 101 cupola
Description: Cupolas are a sophisticated architectural feature often used in high-end homes to add both elegance and functionality to the roofline. These structures, typically perched at the highest point of the roof, are designed to enhance the home’s exterior by introducing a timeless and refined element of design. Cupolas can be crafted in various shapes, including square, round, or octagonal, and are made from premium materials such as copper, lead-coated copper, freedom gray copper, zinc, or aluminum
